review_fixes.loader_generator: DataLoader gets torch.Generator(seed + epoch) so the worker base-seed draw no longer consumes the global CPU RNG.
review_fixes.resume_provenance: checkpoints store provenance = {source: git_sha, dirty, package_sha256 (sorted relpath+sha256 of alaska2/*.py), versions: runtime_versions()}; resume is rejected when any key differs (tests: git_sha, package_sha256, torch version), and each accepted continuation records its provenance in run_manifest.resumes.
review_fixes.verify_membership: verify asserts exact (image, kind) coverage of role=valid (or the full Test set) before inference and rejects saved label/fold/family_id/quality that differ from canonical records; metrics use canonical labels. 4 rejection tests (fit-row predictions, 4 missing holdout rows, flipped labels, shifted fold) each failed with DID NOT RAISE on the previous evaluate.py and pass now.
